g.title: cluster_loop
g.text: THE GRADIENT LOOP · realized $ drives the search

g.title: gap_frame
g.text: TUNABLE FRAME (all args are addressable slots)

g.title: lever_hidden
g.text: skews the pool the vault prices against
✕ chosen by the mutator deep in get_next_call
✕ NOT a slot in the frame — no tuner can reach it

g.title: promote
g.text: P R O M O T E
hoist the lever UP into the frame

g.title: aposteriori
g.text: run frame, record per-STEP erc20 inflow;

g.title: locate
g.text: L O C A T E
which ARG of the lever is the knob?
sweep args → measure Δ ledger / Δ arg

g.title: amplify
g.text: A M P L I F Y
turn the knob to the interior PROFIT PEAK
signed secant roots the DERIVATIVE (g1>0, g2<0)
Idle → Probe1 → Probe2 → secant (across mutate calls)

g.title: peak
g.text: TOO MUCH → pool reverts / self-arb loss
profit lives at the PEAK in between
